topic.label: Securities Offerings and Going Public
topic.desc: Raising capital and taking a company public: IPOs, follow-on and secondary offerings, private placements and exempt offerings, bookbuilding and allocation, SPACs and direct listings, and how investors participate.

concepts.label: SPACs and Direct Listings
concepts.desc: Alternative paths to public markets: SPAC mergers, direct listings and uplistings.

concepts.label: Bookbuilding, Allocation and Participation
concepts.desc: How an offering is marketed, the order book built, priced and allocated, and how institutional and retail investors participate.

concepts.label: Debt Offerings
concepts.desc: Issuing bonds and notes: investment grade and high yield deals, indentures, ratings and syndication.

concepts.label: Private Placements and Exempt Offerings
concepts.desc: Raising capital without full registration: Reg D, Rule 144A, Reg S, Reg A+, PIPEs and accredited investors.

concepts.label: Follow-On, Secondary and Shelf Offerings
concepts.desc: Offerings after the IPO: follow-ons, secondary sales by holders, shelf registrations, at-the-market programs and block trades.

concepts.label: Initial Public Offerings
concepts.desc: Taking a company public: readiness, underwriters, S-1 registration, SEC review, roadshow, pricing and listing.

skills.label: Path to Public Comparator
skills.desc: Compares IPO, SPAC and direct listing by cost, time, dilution and certainty.

skills.label: Greenshoe Explainer
skills.desc: Explains the overallotment option and stabilization after pricing.

skills.label: Participation Guide
skills.desc: Explains how an investor participates in an offering: indications of interest, eligibility, allocation and settlement.

skills.label: Bond Deal Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a bond offering's process, documents, rating and pricing versus benchmark.

skills.label: Exemption Selector
skills.desc: Compares Reg D, 144A, Reg S and Reg A+ for a raise by investor type, limits and resale rules.

skills.label: Offering Type Explainer
skills.desc: Explains follow-on, secondary, shelf, ATM and block trade offerings and when each is used.

skills.label: IPO Readiness Plan
skills.desc: Plans IPO readiness: audits, governance, reporting, underwriters and timeline.

skills.label: Prospectus Reader
skills.desc: Reads an S-1 or prospectus and summarizes the business, risks, use of proceeds and terms.

mcp.name: SEC EDGAR MCP
mcp.desc: SEC EDGAR MCP server: company filings, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financial data and insider trading forms from EDGAR.
